title: Scroll of Counterspell

sources.title: Scrolls
markers: A character of any class can cast

summary: Reaction when an enemy casts a spell.

fields.Cast: Level 3. Spend a Reaction and consume the scroll. No spell slot required.
fields.Effect: Reaction when a nearby caster casts a spell. Stop spells of level 3 or lower, including cantrips. Higher levels require an Intelligence check against DC 10 plus spell level, despite the tooltip’s spellcasting-ability wording. Counterspell itself cannot be counterspelled. The linked spell works while Silenced.
fields.Scroll rules: Any class can cast this in BG3 if able to cast spells. Applicable attack rolls and saves use your proficiency bonus and item spellcasting ability. A Counterspelled scroll is not consumed.

changes: Added exact native BG3 scroll activation, spell mechanics, and shared item-casting rules from pinned sources. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
